findings.defect: Formats Ma Junggeol’s barely audible speech as an unspoken thought.
findings.rationale: His lips move around words he cannot bring himself to say loudly; the source presents them as speech.

findings.current: Of course, until then, we hadn’t even dared consider it.
findings.defect: Says they had not considered the route before searching for it, contradicting their years of planning.
findings.rationale: They had considered and investigated the route but had not dared undertake it.
findings.replacement: Of course, we hadn’t dared attempt it all that time.

findings.current: ‘You idiots should’ve gone to Gansu from the start. Why are you still sitting on your asses here?’
findings.defect: “From the start” changes the Lord’s rebuke about their delay into advice about their original destination.
findings.rationale: 진작 means they should already have left for Gansu.
findings.replacement: ‘You idiots should’ve gone to Gansu ages ago. Why are you still sitting on your asses here?’
findings.source: 진작 감숙으로 갔어야 할 놈들이 왜 아직도 여기에 엉덩이를 붙이고 앉아 있느냐고.

findings.current: “It’s important. If not now, I won’t get another chance.”
findings.defect: Turns a restriction on when the conversation can happen into a claim that Namho will never have another opportunity.
findings.rationale: The source says this is something he cannot say unless it is now, without declaring that no future chance will exist.
findings.replacement: “It’s important. I can only tell you now.”
findings.source: “중요한 이야기일세. 지금이 아니라면 할 수 없는.”

findings.current: He drank several bowls of liquor as if he couldn’t care less, then said,
findings.defect: Drops the pointed image of treating their report like a dog barking.
findings.rationale: The comparison supplies the Lord’s dismissive, comic reaction rather than merely stating indifference.
findings.replacement: He knocked back several bowls of liquor as though he were listening to a dog bark, then said,
findings.source: 어디서 개가 짖냐는 듯이 술만 몇 사발 들이켜시더니 그러시더이다.

findings.current: “Y-young Master Jin asked us earlier how long it would take to bring the Lord back with us, didn’t he? I was answering that.”
findings.defect: Invents an address and omits the speaker’s deferential identification of Taekyung as Jeok Cheongang’s Disciple.
findings.rationale: 제자분 refers to Jeok’s Disciple, preserving the relationship and the speaker’s respectful register.
findings.replacement: “Y-your Disciple over there asked us earlier how long it would take to bring the Lord back, didn’t he? That’s what I was answering.”
findings.source: 저, 저기 계신 제자분께서 아까 저희에게 물어보시지 않았습니까. 대인을 모시고 돌아오기까지 어느 정도의 시일이 걸리겠냐고. 거기에 대해 대답해 드린 겁니다.

findings.current: “Enough! ‘Why not,’ you say? He’s already done a great service by sending the seven of us to warn you about Dark Heaven. It must be an excellent choice for the Lord too, since…”
findings.defect: Renders the short man’s repeated exclamation as a command to stop, obscuring why Jeok strikes him for making that sound again.
findings.rationale: 갈 is his shouted exclamation here, not a rebuke addressed to the other speaker; Jeok reacts to its repetition.
findings.replacement: “Hah! ‘Not a bad idea,’ you say? He’s already done a great service by sending the seven of us to warn you about Dark Heaven. It’s bound to be an excellent choice for the Lord too, since…”
findings.source: “갈! 나쁘지 않다니! 이미 우리 일곱 형제를 보내어 암천에 대한 경고를 하신 것만으로도 큰 공을 세우셨으니 필시 대인께도 아주 좋은 선택이 될…….”

findings.current: “You little shit! I told you to stop barking! Were you not listening to a word this old man said?”
findings.defect: Makes Jeok’s complaint generic instead of identifying the particular exclamation he forbade.
findings.rationale: 갈갈거리지 말라니까 explicitly refers back to the short man’s repeated 갈.
findings.replacement: “You little shit! I told you to stop shouting ‘Hah!’ Did my words go in one ear and out the other?”
findings.source: “이런 호로 새끼를 봤나, 갈갈거리지 말라니까 노부의 말을 귓등으로 들어?”

summary: The draft preserves the scene overall, but changes a few consequential details of timing, speech, and address.
